suppress.notes: CVE-2026-66299 - Tomcat 11.0.24 is the latest available version. No patch available at this time. Will update when Spring Boot ships a newer Tomcat version. Applies to all tomcat-embed artifacts.
CVE-2026-34479, CVE-2026-34477, CVE-2026-49844 - log4j artifacts are transitive dependencies of Spring Boot. No patch available in current Spring Boot 3.5.x. Applies to all log4j artifacts.
CVE-2025-48924 - commons-lang3 3.17.0 is the latest version shipped by Spring Boot 3.5.x. No patch available at this time.
CVE-2026-54515 - jackson-databind 2.21.4 is the latest version shipped by Spring Boot 3.5.x. No patch available at this time.
GHSA-55q2-fjhq-7xh7 - DOMPurify vulnerability in swagger-ui. Swagger UI is only used in development/documentation endpoints, not exposed in production.
commons-io 2.8.0 - false positive. Referenced only in embedded pom.xml inside velocity-engine-core jar, not a runtime dependency. Velocity is used only by build tools.

CVE-2026-53914 - Affects Kotlin build cache metadata deserialization, not runtime code. kotlin-stdlib is a transitive runtime dependency of okhttp-jvm used by resend-java SDK. The vulnerability requires access to Kotlin build toolchain cache, which is not present in a Spring Boot production deployment. Fix available in Kotlin 2.4.20 but that version breaks okhttp-jvm compatibility. Will update when a compatible stable version is available. JetBrains rates this as medium severity (6.7), NVD score of 9.8 is disputed.
